2613.name: WRONG_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD_OR_MAIL_ADDRESS
2613.message:
The information entered is not correct.
You may have entered the ID of another
service.

Please enter the details again, making
sure that the Nintendo Network ID,
password, and e-mail address are
correct.
2613.short_description: Invalid account information provided. Either your username, password, or email address does not match.
2613.long_description: Invalid account information provided. Either your username, password, or email address does not match.
2613.short_solution: Enter the correct information and try again. You might also be connected to Samtendo Network while trying to sign in with an NNID, or Nintendo Network while trying to sign in with an SNID.
2613.long_solution: Enter the correct information and try again. Double check if your information is correct by attempting to sign in on the Samtendo website. You might also be connected to Samtendo Network while trying to sign in with an NNID, or Nintendo Network while trying to sign in with an SNID.
